# Farvist components

All class names below exist in `farvist.min.css` 1.8.1. `{color}` is one of: primary, secondary, success, danger, warning, info, accent, light, dark.

## buttons

Classes: `btn`, `btn-{color}`, `btn-outline-{color}`, `btn-gradient-{primary|sunset|aurora}`, `btn-glass`, `btn-link`, `btn-sm`, `btn-lg`, `btn-block`

```html
<button class="btn btn-gradient-primary">Save</button>
```

## badges

Classes: `badge`, `badge-{color}`, `badge-soft-{color}`, `badge-pill`

```html
<span class="badge badge-soft-success">New</span>
```

## alerts

Classes: `alert`, `alert-{color}`, `alert-heading`

```html
<div class="alert alert-info">Heads up.</div>
```

## cards

Classes: `card`, `card-body`, `card-header`, `card-footer`, `card-title`, `card-text`, `card-glow`, `card-solid`, `hover-lift`

```html
<div class="card"><div class="card-body"><h3 class="card-title">Title</h3></div></div>
```

## chips

Classes: `chip`, `chip-{color}`, `chip-close`

```html
<span class="chip chip-primary">Design <button class="chip-close" aria-label="Remove">&times;</button></span>
```

## avatar

Classes: `avatar`, `avatar-{sm|lg|xl}`, `avatar-{color}`, `avatar-status`, `avatar-group`

```html
<span class="avatar avatar-primary">AL</span>
```

## forms

Classes: `form-control`, `form-label`, `form-text`, `form-select`, `form-check`, `is-invalid`, `invalid-feedback`, `input-group`, `input-group-text`

```html
<label class="form-label" for="e">Email</label><input id="e" class="form-control">
```

## range

Classes: `form-range`

```html

```

## switch

Classes: `switch`

```html

```

## table

Classes: `table`, `table-hover`, `table-responsive`

```html

```

## navbar

Classes: `navbar`, `navbar-brand`, `navbar-nav`, `nav-link`, `navbar-toggle (data-fv-nav-toggle)`, `sticky-top`

```html

```

## dropdown

Classes: `dropdown (<details>)`, `dropdown-menu`, `dropdown-menu-end`, `dropdown-item`, `dropdown-divider`

```html

```

## modal

Classes: `modal (<dialog>)`, `modal-header`, `modal-title`, `modal-body`, `modal-footer`, `modal-close`

```html
<button data-fv-open="#m">Open</button><dialog class="modal" id="m">…</dialog>
```

## tabs

Classes: `tabs`, `tab (data-fv-tab="#id")`, `tab-panel`

```html
<div class="tabs"><button class="tab active" data-fv-tab="#p1">One</button></div><div class="tab-panel active" id="p1">…</div>
```

## accordion

Classes: `accordion-item (<details>)`, `<summary> (styled by element, no class needed)`, `accordion-body`

```html
<details class="accordion-item" open><summary>Q</summary><div class="accordion-body">A</div></details>
```

## toast

Classes: `(JS only)`

```html

```

## tooltip

Classes: `data-tooltip="text"`

```html

```

Classes: `progress`, `progress-bar`, `progress-striped`, `progress-animated`

